Images4,5 are our established Daoist Q style only.
Output exactly five coherent new opposite-side drawings, not a pixel-mirrored copy of image1: show correct far-side anatomy, scarf fold and lighting consistently. All face screen LEFT, nearly true side profile like source12–17. Maintain compact rounded head, short low branching crystal antlers and short scarf; no body or long neck. Each full occupied alpha bbox around337px wide356px tall, W/H21:23=0.913 within5%. Do not revert to tall antlers.

HD original2D handpainting, clean readable contour at mobile thumbnail size, gentle fur detail, crystalline lavender/apricot facets, delicate scarf fabric. True alpha background, no text, checkerboard, frame, glow, sparkles, shadow, props, wings or scenery.
